geometry_edits: Added metre-based facade UVs so brick courses run horizontally rather than sampling as vertical stripes.
Moved the schematic sanctuary interior under the west/north gabled church component and compressed paired pews around a central aisle.
Added stone story stringcourses to long elevations.
Added schematic second-floor classroom slab, partitions with door openings, classroom groups, bookcases, stair treads, and railings.
Removed the superseded room-spanning office partitions and replaced them with door-connected story partitions and a stairwell opening.
uncertainty: Parish confirms three connected components but public plans do not identify their exact current junctions or internal partitions.
The sanctuary-to-gable placement is an evidence-guided interpretation; exact room layout, furniture, stair position, dimensions, roof pitch and tower height remain unverified.
The second-floor classroom plan and stair are schematic, not measured; source GIS outline is a footprint reference, not surveyed wall lines.
